Add to `File` menu before `Reload Selected Tracks` a menu item labeled `Rename Track Files` followed by `Rename Selected Track Files` followed by `Rename Track Files Config...` followed by a divider. 2. When `Rename Track Files Config...` is selected, a sheet window will open on the key editor window. The rename sheet will contain: - At top a read only Text view labeled "Rename Example" that contains the first selected track's filename (the last component of the file path). - Under the filename text view will be a single line TextField labeled "Rename Format", followed by a checkbox labeled "Zero Pad". Editing in "Rename Format" field will change the "Rename Example" text based on formatting rules. - The rename formatting rules are: - characters entered default to literals unless surrounded by '|' - characters surrounded by '|' (e.g. |TITLE|) are to be interpreted as a tag key (e.g. |TITLE| is the track title tag key) - ideally when the user completes a tag character sequence by entering the trailing '|' the app will validate the tag entered against know tags (see AppleScript track properties for larger list) and capitalize the te

Zero padding of numbers will be done by using the dedicated tags: `|zpTRACKNUMBER|`, `|zpDISCNUMBER|`, `|zpTOTALTRACKS|`, `|zpTOTALDISCS|`, `|zpTRACKTOTAL|`, `|zpDISCTOTAL|`. 3. As has been established already, the tag `TOTALTRACKS` is synonymous with `TRACKTOTAL`: - The user can enter `|total tracks|` and it will resolve to `|TOTALTRACKS|` - The user can enter `|track total|` and it will resolve to `|TRACKTOTAL|` - The default conversion for something that is plausibly the `TOTALTRACKS` tag is converted to `|TOTALTRACKS|` (e.g. `|track count|` is converted to `|TOTALTRACKS|`). 4.
